hero.label: Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande
hero.title: Supporting cardiovascular medical research
hero.desc: Founded in 2000, the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande supports scientists who advance cardiovascular medicine through its Scientific Prize and Research Grants.

intro.label: Our vocation
intro.title: Contributing to cardiovascular research
intro.p1: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande aims to contribute, through financial support, to medical research in the cardiovascular field in the broadest sense, including: physiology, biology, medicine, epidemiology, pharmacology, cell differentiation, congenital malformations.
intro.p2: Each year, it awards a Scientific Grand Prize to a renowned international scientist and grants to young French post-doctoral researchers working full-time on cardiovascular topics.

grand_prix.title: Scientific Grand Prize
grand_prix.desc: Awarded annually since 2002 to an international scientist who has made a major contribution to cardiovascular physiology, biology or medicine.

grants.title: Research Grants
grants.desc: Awarded annually since 2001 to young post-doctoral researchers working full-time in a French research institution on cardiovascular topics.

suggestions.label: Go further
suggestions.title: You might also be interested in
suggestions.desc: Discover the resources and partner organizations of the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande in the field of cardiovascular research.

cta.title: Would you like to apply?
cta.desc: Check our current calls for applications for the Scientific Grand Prize and Research Grants.

about.page_desc: Discover the history and mission of the Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande, founded in 2000 in tribute to Michel Delalande.
about.history_desc: The Fondation Lefoulon-Delalande was created in December 2000 to honour the memory of Mr Michel Delalande, Founder and President of the Delalande pharmaceutical group.
about.xavier_darcos: Xavier Darcos, Chancellor of the Institut de France

grand_prix.page_desc: Created in 2002, the Grand Prize is awarded annually to a scientist who has made a major contribution to cardiovascular medicine.
grand_prix.intro_desc: The Lefoulon-Delalande Grand Prize is worth €600,000. It rewards a scientist who has made a significant contribution to cardiovascular physiology, biology or medicine.
grand_prix.apply_desc: The Grand Prize is open to international nominations. Download the rules and submit your nomination.

grants.page_desc: Created in 2001, the Research Grants support young post-doctoral researchers working in a French research institution.
conditions: Hold a PhD in medicine, science, pharmacy or veterinary science
Work full-time in a French research institution
Conduct research in the cardiovascular field
Research internships abroad are not eligible
